sentences.text: Tasul Sk vs Unknown on 10 June, 2025

In The High Court At Calcutta
10.06.25
Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction S.D Item no.18 Crr 2783 of 2024 In the matter of : Tasul Sk.
Petitioner.
Mr. Tapas Ghosh Mr. Tanmay Chowdhury ...For the petitioner.
Mr. Debabrata Chatterjee Ms. Sudeshna Das ...

The instant application has been filed seeking quashing of the proceeding pending before the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 4th Court at Siuri in connection with Birbhum Cyber Crime Police Station Case No. 3 of 2021 dated January 5,
2021 under Sections 376/417 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66 of the Information Technology Act, 2000 corresponding to G.R. Case NO. 21 of 2021.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, 4th Court at Siuri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It appears from the record that despite service none appears on behalf of the private/opposite party.

In view of the facts the State is directed to notify the private opposite party through concerned police station with regard to the next date of hearing and her right to participate in the proceeding.
Let this matter appear in the list on 4th July, 2025.
Report be filed as well as the case diary be produced on the adjourned date (Ajay Kumar Gupta, J.)
